items.source:
Map types distinguish between entry, key or value-level indexing with the restriction that only a single secondary
index is allowed.
items.translation: Map 类型区分基于条目、键或值的索引，但限制只能使用单个二级索引。

items.source:
The name of the index. If null or empty, then the index name will be generated by Cassandra and will be
unknown unless column metadata is used to discover the generated index name.
items.translation: 索引名称。如果为 null 或空，则 Cassandra 将生成索引名称，除非使用列元数据来发现生成的索引名称，否则该名称将未知。

items.source: Alex Shvid, Matthew T. Adams, Mark Paluch
items.translation: 亚历克斯·什维德，马修·T·亚当斯，马克·帕卢奇

items.source: Identifies a secondary index in the table on a single column.
items.translation: 在表的单列上识别二级索引。

items.source:
@Table
class Person {

        Map<@Indexed String, String> indexedKey; // allows CONTAINS KEY queries
        Map<String, @Indexed String> indexedValue; // allows CONTAINS queries
}
items.translation:
@Table
class Person {

    Map<@Indexed String, String> indexedKey; // 支持 CONTAINS KEY 查询
    Map<String, @Indexed String> indexedValue; // 支持 CONTAINS 查询
}
